context: Asuka lectures on logic, using formal connectives.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: university lecture; formal written-register connectives spoken naturally.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今日は、議論における基本を学びます。
lines.en: Today we study the basics of argument.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured intellectual clarity throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 主張は、根拠及び理由から成り立ちます。
lines.en: A claim consists of grounds and reasons.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured intellectual clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 根拠が弱いと、どうなりますか?
lines.en: What happens if the grounds are weak?
lines.style: engaged young student voice, soft warm curious attentive throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: その主張に対して、反論が出ます。
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured intellectual clarity throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 事実、あるいは経験で、支える必要があります。
lines.en: You must support it with facts or experience.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured intellectual clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: これらを、どう組み合わせるんでしょう。
lines.style: thoughtful young student voice, soft warm curious attentive throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: これらの要素を、順序よく並べます。
lines.en: We arrange these elements in good order.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured intellectual clarity throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 読者に対して、丁寧に示すことが大切です。
lines.en: It's important to present them carefully to the reader.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured intellectual clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 文章における順序も、関係しますか?
lines.en: Does order within the text matter too?
lines.style: engaged young student voice, soft warm curious attentive throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、論理及び構成は、切り離せません。
lines.en: Yes — logic and structure are inseparable.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured intellectual encouraging throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: よく分かりました。練習してみます。
lines.style: grateful young student voice, soft warm resolved appreciative throughout
